name: Li Xiaohong
current_role: Co-actual controller and shareholder (~6.72%), Luoyang Jalon Micro-nano New Materials Co. (688357.SH)
profile: Li Xiaohong is listed alongside chairman Li Jianbo as an ultimate controller of Luoyang Jalon Micro-nano New Materials, a Luoyang, Henan maker of molecular sieves and activated alumina founded in 1998 and listed on Shanghai's STAR Market in 2019. Her wealth derives from that stake.
interesting_fact: Jalon Micro-nano, founded in 1998 as Luoyang Jianlong Chemical, makes molecular sieve powders and molded molecular sieves used in industrial gas separation and purification; it listed on the STAR Market in 2019.
notes: Controller listing (Li Jianbo 27.71%, Li Xiaohong 6.72%) per basic.10jqka.com.cn/688357/holder.html. Her own executive role and relationship to Li Jianbo not confirmed in sources read. Low public profile; route via company IR / chairman Li Jianbo.

name: Peng You
current_role: Chairman, Anhui Coreach Technology Co., Ltd. (002983.SZ), Hefei
profile: Peng You is chairman and, with his wife Wang Lingli, co-actual controller of Anhui Coreach Technology (Xinruida), a Hefei company founded in 2012 that makes display backlight modules, quantum-dot and Mini LED display modules, automotive displays and healthy smart lighting systems; it is listed in Shenzhen.
interesting_fact: In a 2022 China Securities Journal interview Peng said Coreach was pushing into semiconductor packaging, in-car displays and smart sensing, had IATF16949 automotive certification and had already sent Mini LED display samples to local carmakers.
deep_cut_fact: Peng told China Securities Journal (May 2022) that Coreach was developing 570nm-plus wavelength light sources paired with sensors to shine into skin tissue, so they could serve as heart-rate modules in smart wearables.
notes: Peng You and Wang Lingli are husband and wife and joint actual controllers per the IPO prospectus (SZSE disclosure). A third-party data source has listed him as CEO with a ~55% stake. Best route is the company board office.
